Building no-code automations with natural language in an M365 environment
AI-powered approval and routing workflows over M365 data
integrations: All Microsoft 365 services: SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, Dynamics
governance_note: Power Automate is the automation layer most M365 organizations already have but rarely inventory. The governance gap is that any M365 user can build and run automations, including AI automations via AI Builder, without IT approval. A process that was manually reviewed yesterday can be automated today without any change record. The control requirement is an automation inventory and approval workflow, not just policy: automations that touch sensitive data or make business decisions need the same change management as any other system change.
training_optout: Microsoft's commercial data terms apply. AI Builder processing stays within the Azure tenant.
